WITH store_sales_filtered AS (
    SELECT * 
    FROM store_sales 
    JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk 
    WHERE date_dim.d_year = 2002 
      AND date_dim.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
),
web_sales_filtered AS (
    SELECT * 
    FROM web_sales 
    JOIN date_dim ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk 
    WHERE date_dim.d_year = 2002 
      AND date_dim.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
),
catalog_sales_filtered AS (
    SELECT * 
    FROM catalog_sales 
    JOIN date_dim ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk 
    WHERE date_dim.d_year = 2002 
      AND date_dim.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
)
SELECT 
    cd.cd_gender, 
    cd.cd_marital_status, 
    cd.cd_education_status, 
    COUNT(*) AS cnt1, 
    cd.cd_purchase_estimate, 
    COUNT(*) AS cnt2, 
    cd.cd_credit_rating, 
    COUNT(*) AS cnt3
FROM customer c
JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN web_sales_filtered w ON c.c_customer_sk = w.ws_bill_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_sales_filtered cs ON c.c_customer_sk = cs.cs_ship_customer_sk
WHERE ca.ca_state IN ('IL', 'TX', 'ME')
  AND w.ws_bill_customer_sk IS NULL
  AND cs.cs_ship_customer_sk IS NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 
      FROM store_sales_filtered ss 
      WHERE ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  )
ORDER BY cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_education_status, cd.cd_purchase_estimate, cd.cd_credit_rating
LIMIT 100
